name: employment_type
description: salaried | sep (self-employed professional) | seb (self-employed business); selects the rule set

name: employer_category
description: govt | psu | defence | listed_mnc | private_large | private_small | other

name: profession
description: doctor | ca | cs | cost_accountant | architect | engineer | consultant | other (sep only)

name: total_experience_months
description: Total work experience at application date

name: current_job_tenure_months
description: Months with current employer (payslips / DOJ)

name: business_vintage_months
description: Months since business/practice start (GST/registration); NULL for salaried

name: net_monthly_income
description: Take-home income after tax and PF (payslip / bank statement)

name: itr_income_y1
description: Total income in latest filed ITR; NULL for salaried

name: itr_income_y2
description: Total income in previous ITR; NULL if fewer than 2 filed

name: itr_years_filed
description: Number of assessment years with a filed ITR

name: existing_emi_monthly
description: Sum of EMIs on active loans in bureau report

name: credit_card_outstanding
description: Revolving outstanding; monthly load = 5% (estimated) added to obligations

name: bureau_score
description: CIBIL/Experian score; NULL = new to credit (never 0)

name: credit_history_months
description: Age of oldest trade line; NULL if none

name: max_dpd_last_12m
description: Worst days-past-due in last 12 months; NULL if no history

name: enquiries_last_6m
description: Hard enquiries in last 6 months

name: writeoff_or_settled_24m
description: Any write-off or settlement in last 24 months

name: active_unsecured_loans
description: Count of active unsecured trade lines

name: city_tier
description: From data/lookups/city_tier.csv (GoI HRA X/Y/Z); pincode used only for lookup

name: residence_type
description: owned | rented | company | parental

name: salary_account_with_lender
description: Bank where salary is credited

name: requested_tenure_months
description: Optional requested tenure

name: age_at_application
description: (application_date - DOB)/365.25; never a stored age

name: age_at_maturity
description: F23 + tenure/12

name: max_tenure_by_age_L
description: min(product max tenure, (maturity cap - F23) x 12) per lender

name: assessed_income_L
description: Income as the lender reads it (net vs gross; SE: latest ITR/12)

name: emi_capacity_L
description: F26 x foir_limit_L - F27 (or take-home floor rule)

name: post_loan_foir
description: (F27 + EMI of requested loan) / F26

name: bureau_clean_flag
description: F15 < 30 (or NULL) and not F17

name: itr_income_growth
description: (F08 - F09) / F09; NULL if fewer than 2 ITRs

name: foir_headroom
description: foir_limit_L - F30; negative = over limit; drives counterfactual fixes
